name: Integrated C1–C8 package
status_profile: intrinsic plus interface-relative, history-dependent, and maintained
promise: Keeps the richest consciousness-relevant target contract in view.
failure_surface: No integrated source or target instance is inherited; separate clause witnesses do not glue automatically.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs a heterogeneous package morphism and a target-native coherence re-audit.

name: Terminal predictive quotient
status_profile: intrinsic relative to an admissible continuation family; interface-relative
promise: Separates current/public matching from future-sufficient organization.
failure_surface: Quotient isomorphism does not preserve full package, hidden implementation, token identity, or autonomy.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs separately typed continuation alphabets and a comparison of reachable predictive fibers.

name: Predictive transition system
status_profile: history-sensitive and protocol-relative through admissible continuations
promise: Adds dynamics and admissible futures to quotient-state matching.
failure_surface: A matched transition graph can still omit binding, credit, temporal minting, and viability.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs input/clock translation and a proof that the bridge respects continuation semantics.

name: Continuation algebra
promise: Makes preservation of all admissible continuation tests explicit.
failure_surface: The test family may be incomplete or chosen to hard-code preferred cases.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs noncircular admissible-test translation and composition across bridge stages.

name: Closure operator and fixed point
status_profile: intrinsic to a declared law basis but realization-relative
promise: Turns promoted package realization into a commuting closure/fixed-point question.
failure_surface: A common fixed point can be shared by independent realizations and need not carry lineage.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs embeddings or a span that commute with closure and preserve globally glued witnesses.

name: Viability kernel plus endogenous maintenance law
promise: Makes post-handoff self-maintenance and repair first-class.
failure_surface: Sufficient resources or viability do not identify which source package continued.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs resource/currency translation and a controlled-simulation theorem with margins.

name: Reflexive self-coordinate
promise: Tests whether the target inherits an endogenous self-model rather than a copied label.
failure_surface: A copied self-description can be a public token without reflexive update structure.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs a typed translation of self-reference and endogenous update provenance.

name: Temporal closure triple and ledger history
status_profile: intrinsic order plus clock/interface relations; strongly history-dependent
promise: Prevents endpoint matching from erasing package-minted order and phase history.
failure_surface: No canonical synchronized now or clock transport is inherited.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs a monotone clock connection, dormant-interval semantics, and route-holonomy audit.

name: Recombination and refinement structure
promise: Retains joint information lost by branchwise or endpoint summaries.
failure_surface: Preserving branch marginals does not preserve recombination or global event structure.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs a functor preserving refinement, fusion, marks, and composition defects.

name: Action-credit and mineness ledger
promise: Distinguishes target behavior from source-owned or protocol-owned output.
failure_surface: A ledger can be copied syntactically while its minting authority remains external.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs provenance transport and a criterion for target-native credit minting.

name: Quality-space geometry up to gauge
status_profile: representation-relative with a proposed gauge-invariant core
promise: Could separate representational redescription from preserved relational geometry.
failure_surface: The corpus does not supply a cross-carrier quality-space recognition or lineage theorem.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs a justified gauge group, observable invariants, and relation to C1–C8.

name: Globally glued event package
promise: Blocks assembly of one subject/package from merely pairwise admissible edges.
failure_surface: Local witnesses can fail cycles, roles, binding, time, or recombination constraints.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs a heterogeneous descent datum and proof of global coherence.

name: Relation among source and target histories
promise: Naturally represents fission, fusion, empty targets, and nonunique continuation.
failure_surface: A relation can be too permissive and still does not imply personal identity.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs an admissible witness definition and a composition law through branch/fusion episodes.

name: Error-corrected logical package
promise: Offers the clearest engineering pattern for persistence over changing support.
failure_surface: The consciousness code space and recovery map are not supplied by analogy.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs a declared code, recovery channel, logical defect, and target-native recovery test.

name: Minimal multi-layer continuation bundle
promise: May preserve the strongest discriminators without demanding every full-package clause.
failure_surface: Feature selection can become ad hoc and threshold tuning can encode preferred verdicts.
cross_carrier_debt: Needs a minimality theorem or counterexample-driven justification for every included component.
